versions.changelog:
- Documentation updated: README.md has been revised with new content or instructions.
- Obsolete or redundant documentation file skill-card.md has been removed.

oracle-x-api 1.0.4

- Removed all Borsa İstanbul (BIST), TEFAS, KAP, and VİOP coverage from the description and usage guide; these now belong to the separate oracle-x-bist skill.
- Clarified that Turkish symbols and BIST endpoints are not handled here and will not resolve.
- Updated endpoint guide to point all `/api/bist/*` and related queries to oracle-x-bist.
- Streamlined instructions and examples to match surface now limited to crypto and global equities.
- No functional API changes; documentation and positioning update only.

Version 1.0.3

- Expanded the documented feature set to include Polymarket odds, BIST (Borsa İstanbul) data (equities, funds, filings, futures, macro), and return breakdowns (nominal/real/USD).
- Updated endpoint guidance and usage table in SKILL.md and endpoints.md, reflecting new and specialized Turkish market support.
- Adjusted descriptions to clarify support for prediction markets, inflation-adjusted returns, and entity-level positioning.
- Removed legacy file skill-card.md from the repository.
- README and docs now guide users on quoting returns and using new endpoints without misinterpreting inflation as performance.

Version 1.0.2

- Added a README.md file to the repository.
Initial publish: read a running Oracle-X instance — prices, technical zones, news analysis, macro regime, chains, liquidations, ownership, and the vector memory.
